features.name: molecular_complexity_score
features.description: Normalized composite of ring count, branching, and heteroatom indicators scaled to unit range using training statistics. Captures overall molecular structural complexity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear SVM benefits from smooth composite scores that project complex structural information onto a single axis separating biodegradable from non-biodegradable compounds.

features.name: lipophilicity_proxy
features.description: Approximation of lipophilicity using log-based molecular descriptors V1 and V2, which relate to molecular size and polarity. Higher values suggest more hydrophobic compounds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Lipophilicity is a key driver of biodegradability; a smooth continuous proxy helps linear SVM find a clean decision boundary.

features.name: heteroatom_density
features.description: Ratio of heteroatom-related counts (V9, V10, V11) to molecular size proxy V8, normalized. Reflects proportion of polar functional groups relative to molecular weight.
features.expected_model_benefit: Heteroatom density correlates with water solubility and biodegradability; ratio features provide scale-invariant signals useful for SVM margins.

features.name: electronic_polarity_index
features.description: Composite of electronic descriptors V12 and V28 capturing charge distribution asymmetry. Absolute deviation from neutral combined with sign-weighted sum.
features.expected_model_benefit: Electronic polarity affects molecular reactivity and biodegradation pathways; smooth continuous index improves linear separability.

features.name: topological_surface_ratio
features.description: Ratio of topological polar surface area proxy (V15) to molecular volume proxy (V13), capturing surface accessibility relative to size.
features.expected_model_benefit: Surface-to-volume ratio is a key physicochemical property; normalized ratio features are well-suited for linear SVM decision boundaries.

features.name: aromatic_saturation_balance
features.description: Balance between aromatic ring indicators (V23) and saturated chain indicators (V34, V35), normalized by total count. Negative values indicate more aromatic character.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aromatic vs aliphatic balance strongly influences biodegradation rate; this signed ratio provides a linear projection useful for SVM.

features.name: molecular_weight_normalized
features.description: Log-transformed and standardized molecular weight proxy using V8, centered at training mean and scaled by training std.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized molecular weight provides a smooth continuous feature; log transformation reduces skewness for better linear SVM performance.

features.name: connectivity_index_composite
features.description: Weighted combination of connectivity-related descriptors V36, V37, V39 capturing molecular graph topology. Standardized using training means.
features.expected_model_benefit: Connectivity indices encode molecular graph structure; weighted composite provides a smooth linear projection for SVM.

features.name: functional_group_count_log
features.description: Log-transformed total count of functional group indicators (V3, V4, V5, V6, V7) capturing overall functional group richness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Functional group richness is a key biodegradability predictor; log transformation handles count skewness for linear SVM.

features.name: branching_complexity_ratio
features.description: Ratio of branching descriptor V31 to linear chain proxy V30, capturing degree of molecular branching relative to chain length.
features.expected_model_benefit: Branching affects biodegradation accessibility; ratio feature provides scale-invariant signal for linear SVM margin optimization.

features.name: polarity_size_interaction
features.description: Semantic assessment of the interaction between molecular polarity (based on V12, V14) and molecular size (V8, V1). Score from 0 to 10 where higher values indicate large polar molecules more likely to be biodegradable due to water solubility. Assessed by combining normalized polarity and size signals.
features.expected_model_benefit: Interaction between polarity and size captures non-additive effects on biodegradability that a linear SVM can exploit as a pre-computed feature.

features.name: structural_diversity_score
features.description: Entropy-like diversity measure across multiple structural descriptor groups (ring systems, chains, heteroatoms, functional groups) normalized to 0-1 range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Structural diversity captures overall molecular complexity in a single smooth score; useful for linear SVM as a summary feature.
